mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Treat belief, model, frame, attention, and connection fields as primitive section-configuration variables and postulate a gauge-covariant extended-real action.
mechanism_families.representation: Compact measured base; finite agent cover; Sobolev statistical sections; typed overlap transports; local VFE plus peer, spatial, and connection sectors.
mechanism_families.invariant_or_obstruction: Gauge covariance is available only after one transformation law is fixed; minimizer existence requires coercivity, compactness or gauge fixing, and lower semicontinuity.
obligations: Repair the base measure and overlap typing.
Define the belief-model joint entering the likelihood.
Prove well-definedness, invariance, existence, variation, dissipation, and the singleton-base limit.
mechanism_families.bridge: Finite designs and a later lattice-to-continuum theorem connect this action to executable and exact finite models.
mechanism_families.failure_test: An admissible undefined term, gauge-dependent value, nonclosed configuration space, or coercivity escape defeats the proposed theorem.
verified_results: The current manuscript supplies the intended action skeleton and exact row minimization, but not the complete continuum theorem.
open_gaps: No frozen corrected action or complete direct-method proof is yet present.
No continuum discretization convergence theorem is yet present.
mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: Gauge-covariant interacting statistical sections with entropy-regularized transported peer KL on overlap domains.

mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Seek one fixed normalized generative joint on the original state variables whose negative ELBO equals the live population scalar.
mechanism_families.representation: Finite or cylindrical state law with a joint recognition distribution.
mechanism_families.invariant_or_obstruction: On the scoped open factorized family, a fixed-joint ELBO is separately affine outside factor entropies, whereas moving-peer KL has a nonzero mixed third variation.
obligations: Retain the theorem's exact factorization and fixed-row scope.
mechanism_families.bridge: Exact local self-VFE, fixed-source rows, ordered source-label models, and zero-within-scale hierarchies remain valid restricted realizations.
mechanism_families.failure_test: A single fixed joint reproducing arbitrary live peer fields on the original sample space would defeat the obstruction.
verified_results: A separate revision-bound verification ledger closes the scoped moving-peer no-go.
open_gaps: The obstruction does not classify every correlated or coarser recognition family.
mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: Exact normalized-law semantics and a representation obstruction for moving variational targets.

mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Promote whole section-valued agent configurations to random variables and use the PIFB2 action as a Gibbs energy.
mechanism_families.representation: A proper Borel reference probability rho_0 on configuration space and P_0(dX)=Z^{-1} exp(-S[X]/T) rho_0(dX).
mechanism_families.invariant_or_obstruction: The Gibbs variational identity is exact if 0<Z<infinity, but it includes configuration entropy and is not the original state-level ELBO.
obligations: Construct a proper reference law on the chosen section space.
Prove partition-function finiteness and gauge-volume control.
Keep observation likelihoods and vacuum configuration energy from double counting.
mechanism_families.bridge: This is the natural optional probabilistic completion of the deterministic continuum action.
mechanism_families.failure_test: An improper reference law, infinite gauge volume, or divergent partition function blocks the construction.
verified_results: The finite measure-theoretic identity is exact conditionally on a proper reference law and finite partition function.
open_gaps: No continuum section-space reference law or normalizability theorem is constructed.
mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: Meta-level generalized Bayesian VFE over complete interacting-agent fields.
